summary: The exact target passes the requested zero-physics execution checks: strict task loading accepts the Praxis binding, detached identity validation rejects wrong issue/path and incomplete bindings, launcher preflight propagates the tracked issue/path, and the protocol, digest gates, zero-step preparation, scene contracts, and no-retry ledger remain enforced.

All 6 selected capability contract tests passed, including nine-case budget, sealed reference digest mismatch handling, progression, and preflight classification.
All 4 capability scene tests passed; selected scenes matched collision contracts and preparation probing left plant steps and time at zero.
A pre-existing campaign ledger rejected another capture with the permanent no-retry error, preserved the ledger, and created no replacement capture.
Target source confirms capture applies the sealed reference digest gate and the independent offline verifier recomputes and applies the same gate.
Target source confirms prepare runs under a guard against plant integration and records physics_steps=0; the zero-step probe test passed in E5.
Relevant task, research identity, and substrate source files are unchanged between the frozen target and prepared starting commit; exact-target worktree remained detached and clean.
Preserved initial failed harness invocation: Python could not import tools because PYTHONPATH was omitted; the same script passed after setting PYTHONPATH in E1.
